_comment: Standalone AIFlowBridge gateway config. Every key is optional; a missing key falls back to the bundled defaults in src/standalone/config-loader.ts. IMPORTANT: keys are NESTED, not flat. The loader splits a dotted key ('gateway.port') and walks the parsed JSON, so a flat 'gateway.port': 8787 is silently ignored. Known limitation: the root 'providers' key can be either the vendor map (object, for the <vendor>.baseUrl keys below) or the VS Code profile list (array, for custom gateway profiles) - it cannot be both at once. This example uses the object form, which is the one that makes the vendor baseUrl overrides work.
